---

config:
    theme: 'base'
    themeVariables:
        primaryColor: '#1f2020'
        primaryTextColor: '#f0f0f0'
        background: '#333'
        primaryBorderColor: '#888888'
        lineColor: '#999'

---

stateDiagram

state "GROUNDED" as GROUNDED {

        IDLE

        IDLE : IDLE

        IDLE : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_02_idle"); }

        IDLE : do / { ApplyGroundFriction(); }

        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
        state "." as GROUNDED.(InitialState)

        RUN

        RUN : RUN

        RUN : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_07_run"); }

        RUN : do / { ApplyRunVelocity(); }

        DASH

        DASH : DASH

        DASH : enter / { StartDash(); }

        DASH : do / { UpdateDashTimer(); }

        DASH : exit / { EndDash(); }

        ATTACK_1

        ATTACK_1 : ATTACK_1

        ATTACK_1 : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_17_saber_slash_1"); }

        ATTACK_1 : enter / { StartAttackHitbox(); }

        ATTACK_1 : exit / { EndAttackHitbox(); }

        ATTACK_RUN

        ATTACK_RUN : ATTACK_RUN

        ATTACK_RUN : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_25_attack_walk_slash"); }

        ATTACK_RUN : do / { ApplyRunVelocity(); }

        ATTACK_DASH

        ATTACK_DASH : ATTACK_DASH

        ATTACK_DASH : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_27_attack_dash_slash"); }

        ATTACK_DASH : do / { ApplyRunVelocity(); }

        ATTACK_2

        ATTACK_2 : ATTACK_2

        ATTACK_2 : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_18_saber_slash_1"); }

        ATTACK_2 : enter / { StartAttackHitbox(); }

        ATTACK_2 : exit / { EndAttackHitbox(); }

        ATTACK_3

        ATTACK_3 : ATTACK_3

        ATTACK_3 : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_21_saber_slash_1"); }

        ATTACK_3 : enter / { StartAttackHitbox(); }

        ATTACK_3 : exit / { EndAttackHitbox(); }

        CHARGE_SLASH

        CHARGE_SLASH : CHARGE_SLASH

        CHARGE_SLASH : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_20_saber_slash_1"); }

        CHARGE_SLASH : enter / { StartAttackHitbox(); }

        CHARGE_SLASH : exit / { EndAttackHitbox(); }

}

%% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
%% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
state "." as ROOT.(InitialState)

state "AIRBORNE" as AIRBORNE {

        JUMP

        JUMP : JUMP

        JUMP : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_08_jump"); }

        JUMP : do / { ApplyAirControl(); }

        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
        state "." as AIRBORNE.(InitialState)

        FALL

        FALL : FALL

        FALL : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_10_jump_somersault"); }

        FALL : do / { ApplyAirControl(); }

        ATTACK_AIR

        ATTACK_AIR : ATTACK_AIR

        ATTACK_AIR : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_26_attack_air_jump_slash"); }

        ATTACK_AIR : do / { ApplyAirControl(); }

        CHARGE_AIR_SLASH

        CHARGE_AIR_SLASH : CHARGE_AIR_SLASH

        CHARGE_AIR_SLASH : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_20_saber_slash_heavy"); }

        CHARGE_AIR_SLASH : enter / { StartHeavyAttackHitbox(); }

        CHARGE_AIR_SLASH : do / { ApplyAirControl(); }

        CHARGE_AIR_SLASH : exit / { EndAttackHitBox(); }

}

state "WALL_SLIDE" as WALL_SLIDE {

        GRAB_WALL

        GRAB_WALL : GRAB_WALL

        GRAB_WALL : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_12_wall_grab_slide"); }

        GRAB_WALL : do / { ApplyWallSlideFriction(); }

        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
        state "." as WALL_SLIDE.(InitialState)

        ATTACK_GRAB_WALL

        ATTACK_GRAB_WALL : ATTACK_GRAB_WALL

        ATTACK_GRAB_WALL : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_18_saber_slash_2"); }

        ATTACK_GRAB_WALL : do / { ApplyWallSlideFriction(); }

        CHARGE_WALL_SLASH

        CHARGE_WALL_SLASH : CHARGE_WALL_SLASH

        CHARGE_WALL_SLASH : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_28_hang_charge_slash"); }

        CHARGE_WALL_SLASH : enter / { StartHeavyAttackHitbox(); }

        CHARGE_WALL_SLASH : do / { ApplyWallSlideFriction(); }

        CHARGE_WALL_SLASH : exit / { EndAttackHitbox(); }

}

state "HURT" as HURT {

        HURT_GROUND

        HURT_GROUND : HURT_GROUND

        HURT_GROUND : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_05_hurt_damage"); }

        HURT_GROUND : enter / { ApplyKnockback(); }

        HURT_GROUND : enter / { StartInvicibility(); }

        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
        state "." as HURT.(InitialState)

        HURT_AIR

        HURT_AIR : HURT_AIR

        HURT_AIR : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_05_hurt_damage"); }

        HURT_AIR : enter / { ApplyAirKnockback(); }

        HURT_AIR : enter / { StartInvicibility(); }

}

state "DEATH" as DEATH {

        DYING

        DYING : DYING

        DYING : enter / { PlayAnim("seq_05_hurt_damage"); }

        DYING : enter / { DisableInput(); }

        DYING : enter / { SpawnDeathParticles(); }

        %% Initial state name as "." so that it fits in black circle shape.
        %% See https://github.com/StateSmith/StateSmith/issues/404
        state "." as DEATH.(InitialState)

}

GROUNDED --> CHARGE_SLASH : CHARGE_RELEASE

GROUNDED --> JUMP : JUMP_PRESS / { ApplyJumpImpulse(); }

GROUNDED --> FALL : FALL [!isGrounded]

GROUNDED --> HURT_GROUND : HIT_RECEIVED [!vars.isInvincible] / { TakeDamage(); }

IDLE --> RUN : MOVE_INPUT

IDLE --> ATTACK_1 : ATTACK_PRESS

IDLE --> CHARGE_SLASH : CHARGE_RELEASE

IDLE --> DASH : DASH_PRESS

GROUNDED.(InitialState) --> IDLE

RUN --> DASH : DASH_PRESS

RUN --> IDLE : STOP_INPUT

RUN --> ATTACK_RUN : ATTACK_PRESS

RUN --> CHARGE_SLASH : CHARGE_RELEASE

DASH --> RUN : DASH_FINISHED [move]

DASH --> ATTACK_DASH : ATTACK_PRESS

DASH --> IDLE : DASH_FINISHED [else]

DASH --> DASH : DASH_PRESS

ATTACK_1 --> IDLE : ATTACK_FINISHED

ATTACK_1 --> ATTACK_2 : ATTACK_PRESS

ATTACK_RUN --> RUN : ATTACK_FINISHED

ATTACK_DASH --> DASH : ATTACK_FINISHED

ATTACK_2 --> ATTACK_3 : ATTACK_PRESS

ATTACK_2 --> IDLE : ATTACK_FINISHED

ATTACK_3 --> IDLE : ATTACK_FINISHED

CHARGE_SLASH --> IDLE : ATTACK_FINISHED

ROOT.(InitialState) --> GROUNDED

AIRBORNE --> CHARGE_AIR_SLASH : CHARGE_RELEASE

AIRBORNE --> GROUNDED : LANDED / { PlayAnim("seq_09_land"); }

AIRBORNE --> WALL_SLIDE : WALL_TOUCH [vars.vy #62; 0 && isTouchingWall]

AIRBORNE --> HURT_AIR : HIT_RECEIVED [!vars.isInvincible] / { TakeDamage(); }

JUMP --> FALL : APEX [vy #62;= 0]

JUMP --> ATTACK_AIR : ATTACK_PRESS

AIRBORNE.(InitialState) --> FALL

FALL --> ATTACK_AIR : ATTACK_PRESS

ATTACK_AIR --> FALL : ATTACK_FINISHED

CHARGE_AIR_SLASH --> FALL : ATTACK_FINISHED

WALL_SLIDE --> CHARGE_WALL_SLASH : CHARGE_RELEASE

WALL_SLIDE --> JUMP : JUMP_PRESS / { ApplyWallJumpImpulse(); }

WALL_SLIDE --> FALL : WALL_DETACH

WALL_SLIDE --> GROUNDED : LANDED

WALL_SLIDE --> HURT_AIR : HIT_RECEIVED [!vars.isInvincible] / { TakeDamage(); }

GRAB_WALL --> ATTACK_GRAB_WALL : ATTACK_PRESS

WALL_SLIDE.(InitialState) --> GRAB_WALL

ATTACK_GRAB_WALL --> GRAB_WALL : ATTACK_FINISHED

CHARGE_WALL_SLASH --> GRAB_WALL : ATTACK_FINISHED

HURT --> DEATH : HURT_FINISHED [vars.hp #60;= 0]

HURT_GROUND --> GROUNDED : HURT_FINISHED [vars.hp #62; 0]

HURT.(InitialState) --> HURT_GROUND

HURT_AIR --> AIRBORNE : HURT_FINISHED [vars.hp #62; 0]

DEATH.(InitialState) --> DYING
StateSmith Simulator
settings delete help
